items.title: Vanderbilt University — BYOD ransomware attack
items.summary: Vanderbilt is responding to a Nov 9 cyberattack that hit devices, systems and cloud services; the BYOD gang claims it encrypted databases and stole student, employee and research data, and most internal systems remain restricted.

items.title: LiveRamp — claimed by N0n
items.summary: The N0n ransomware group listed data-connectivity firm LiveRamp on its leak site; the claim is not confirmed by the company.

items.title: 159 Solutions, Inc. — claimed by N0n
items.summary: N0n added 159 Solutions to its leak site this month as part of a run of US victim postings; unverified by the victim.

items.title: Frolina Home (Thailand) — claimed by Climax Inc
items.summary: The Climax Inc group claims an attack on Thai manufacturer Frolina Home; no victim confirmation.

items.title: Unnamed US organization (Company #188) — N0n claim, Nov 9
items.summary: SOCRadar tracks a Nov 9 N0n claim against an unnamed US organization, consistent with the group's high posting tempo this month.

items.title: Ransomware activity up 23% in Q3 2026
items.summary: NCC Group reports a 23% quarter-over-quarter rise in ransomware attacks in Q3 2026, setting the backdrop for Q4 activity.

ransomware.note: Named, victim-confirmed November cases are scarce; most items are leak-site claims. Treat as unverified until the victim discloses.

items.title: Cloudflare network slowdown — Eastern North America
items.summary: A Cloudflare slowdown across Eastern North America ran roughly 11:34am–3:12pm ET on Nov 9; some Workers changes and a FedRAMP purge item may still be delayed.

items.title: Exchange Online EX1545193 — sends to Outlook.com bounce
items.summary: An open Microsoft incident may cause messages sent to Outlook.com, Hotmail.com and Live.com addresses to bounce.

items.title: Windows 365 Cloud PC drops and Teams TM1545775
items.summary: Windows 365 Cloud PCs were still dropping sessions and some Teams users saw blank contacts as of the Nov 9 evening brief.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b (London) power event — Oct 20
items.summary: A third-party London facility lost utility power and a controller fault kept generators from taking over; reported by commentary sources, not yet verified against Google's status history.

outage.note: No major hyperscaler-wide outage found for November so far; AWS reported all clear on Nov 9.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-111357 / CVE-2026-118527 — KEV deadline Nov 13
items.summary: CISA ordered federal agencies to remediate two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure flaws and perform forensic triage for compromise; the second deadline is Nov 13.

items.title: Node2Shell critical flaw under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA warns attackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell (Brotli) vulnerability and has added it to the KEV catalog.

items.title: Six Microsoft zero-days added to KEV
items.summary: A Nov 6 report says CISA added six actively exploited Microsoft zero-days to KEV; not yet cross-checked against CISA's catalog.

items.title: Apple CVE-2024-27834 added to KEV — due Nov 18
items.summary: CISA added Apple WebKit CVE-2024-27834 to KEV on Nov 4 with a Nov 18 federal remediation deadline.

items.title: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN CVE-2026-19868 — deadline Nov 20
items.summary: Exploited SonicOS SSLVPN flaw carries a Nov 20 federal deadline; edge VPNs remain the leading initial-access vector.

items.title: Cisco zero-days drive CISA Emergency Directive
items.summary: CISA and Five Eyes partners issued emergency guidance on exploited Cisco zero-days; date not confirmed for November, included for active-directive tracking.

items.title: M 6.4 — 30 km WSW of Lata, Solomon Islands (Nov 09)
items.summary: USGS green alert, no tsunami; limited infrastructure impact expected.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Murasu hit the Andhra Pradesh coast on Nov 3, the second cyclone there in under a week.

items.title: Santa Catarina, Brazil — 671 storm incidents
items.summary: Storms caused 671 incidents across 76 municipalities in Santa Catarina on Nov 4–5.

items.title: Ecuador flooding — 12 deaths, 56,000+ affected
items.summary: Heavy rain and flooding killed 12 people and affected more than 56,000 in Ecuador.

items.title: Northern Mexico heavy rain
items.summary: Weekend rain across four northern states left two dead, 450 homes affected and 45 people rescued (reported Nov 2).

physical.note: No significant November wildfire activity found.
